explication: Evil-M5Project is a multi-device ESP32 security-testing toolkit. The principal workflow is: an operator selects a device firmware, scans or interacts with nearby WiFi/Bluetooth environments, optionally launches portals or attacks, and reviews results through the device UI, SD-card files, or a remote web interface. The repository also supplies companion tools for wardriving, tag forensics, CCTV streaming, packet conversion, HID scripting, and reverse TCP control. Several firmware internals are unsampled, so those documented capability links are shown conservatively.
